source.starterDeckDataStatus: Locked v0.7.0 public playtest starter set

decks.name: Forward Doctrine
decks.summary: Offensive tempo, repeated attacks, Command conversion, and immediate Front Line progress.
decks.strategy: Offensive tempo, repeated attacks, Command conversion, and immediate Front Line progress.

decks.name: Holdfast
decks.summary: Make controlled ground brutally difficult to take, convert defensive wins into retreat distance and counterattack pressure, and create prepared retreat traps.
decks.strategy: Make controlled ground brutally difficult to take, convert defensive wins into retreat distance and counterattack pressure, and create prepared retreat traps.

decks.name: Open Channels
decks.summary: Make acceptance attractive, ratify six different Proposals quickly, draw from Good Offices, and retain enough combat leverage that refusal is dangerous.
decks.strategy: Make acceptance attractive, ratify six different Proposals quickly, draw from Good Offices, and retain enough combat leverage that refusal is dangerous.

decks.name: Procedure Endures
decks.summary: Risk substantial Stakes, preserve Influence through Political Capital and Safe Conduct, and make refusal create lasting institutional costs.
decks.strategy: Risk substantial Stakes, preserve Influence through Political Capital and Safe Conduct, and make refusal create lasting institutional costs.

decks.name: Sound Investment
decks.summary: Build Treasury value, exploit Line of Credit, accelerate Deed purchases, and use Corner the Market to threaten Controlling Interest before ordinary Capital pacing would allow it.
decks.strategy: Build Treasury value, exploit Line of Credit, accelerate Deed purchases, and use Corner the Market to threaten Controlling Interest before ordinary Capital pacing would allow it.

decks.name: Hostile Expansion
decks.summary: Win on enemy ground, immediately convert Occupation into Deed/control swings, and use finance cards as battle-linked acquisition tools rather than as a passive economy engine.
decks.strategy: Win on enemy ground, immediately convert Occupation into Deed/control swings, and use finance cards as battle-linked acquisition tools rather than as a passive economy engine.

decks.name: Field Operations
decks.summary: Use Fieldcraft and card effects to operate asymmetrically on hostile terrain, preserve Intel for Surveillance/Interference, and complete field-oriented Missions while dismantling enemy commitments.
decks.strategy: Use Fieldcraft and card effects to operate asymmetrically on hostile terrain, preserve Intel for Surveillance/Interference, and complete field-oriented Missions while dismantling enemy commitments.

decks.name: Mission Network
decks.summary: Keep a Mission active, complete Missions in sequence through Mission Control, recover completed Mission cards, and use Sleeper Network for a high-ceiling action burst.
decks.strategy: Keep a Mission active, complete Missions in sequence through Mission Control, recover completed Mission cards, and use Sleeper Network for a high-ceiling action burst.

decks.name: First Principles
decks.summary: Deliberately move cards from Hand to Graveyard, turn the first sacrifice each turn into replacement card flow, and then reuse the Graveyard as a second tactical hand.
decks.strategy: Deliberately move cards from Hand to Graveyard, turn the first sacrifice each turn into replacement card flow, and then reuse the Graveyard as a second tactical hand.

decks.name: Unbroken Circle
decks.summary: Begin and preserve Rites, protect Ritual progress through defensive wins and high-value Arcane sacrifice, then survive long enough to initiate the required winning battle.
decks.strategy: Begin and preserve Rites, protect Ritual progress through defensive wins and high-value Arcane sacrifice, then survive long enough to initiate the required winning battle.

decks.name: Final Judgment
decks.summary: Win battles, turn those wins into discounted Final Judgment Purges, and accelerate opposing-card depletion toward Purification.
decks.strategy: Win battles, turn those wins into discounted Final Judgment Purges, and accelerate opposing-card depletion toward Purification.

decks.name: Relentless Pursuit
decks.summary: Make attacks fail, convert the failed attack into Relentless Pursuit, and turn the opponent’s lost turn into immediate positional pressure.
decks.strategy: Make attacks fail, convert the failed attack into Relentless Pursuit, and turn the opponent’s lost turn into immediate positional pressure.
